page_title: NEW 1-0 ARS | Newcastle v Arsenal 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+5' That's the end of the game for Bruno Guimaraes, who is replaced by Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd).
90+4' The referee John Brooks awards Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) a yellow card.

90+4' What a chance that is! Declan Rice (Arsenal) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorginho (Arsenal) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but David Raya produces a wonderful reflex save.
86' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorginho (Arsenal) replacing Thomas Partey.
85' Substitution. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) on for Anthony Gordon.
84' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
83' Good movement by Ben White (Arsenal), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
81' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
81' John Brooks has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd). A free kick is awarded to Arsenal.
77' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
75' The game is interrupted now, Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' Substitution. Leandro Trossard did his best and is replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
71' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Ben White (Arsenal) replaces Jurrien Timber.
71' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
70' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared.

70' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
69' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
68' The referee awards a corner and Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take it.

68' Declan Rice (Arsenal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
66' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.
66' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Nick Pope intercepts it and averts the threat.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Joe Willock cannot continue after picking up an injury.

64' Declan Rice (Arsenal) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.

64' A neat pass finds Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the left side of the goal, but David Raya denies him with a good save.
62' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is booked.
61' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Gabriel Martinelli is replaced by Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) replaces Mikel Merino.
60' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman signals a throw-in for Newcastle.
59' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

58' A wild pass somehow finds Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
56' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
56' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee John Brooks saw the whole situation.
54' The resulting corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the defence.
51' The resulting set piece from Arsenal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
51' The game is pretty dull as Arsenal are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
50' The ball is behind the touchline and Newcastle will take a throw-in.
48' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. There is a free kick near the sideline to Arsenal.

46' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. David Raya has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' John Brooks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
39' This is a yellow card! Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

39' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
36' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' John Brooks blows for a foul after Mikel Merino (Arsenal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Newcastle.
32' Declan Rice (Arsenal) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
29' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a throw-in.

29' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick to Newcastle.
27' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
27' There's an opportunity for Declan Rice (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
26' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
25' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

24' A lofted cross from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag and Newcastle will take a corner.
24' Declan Rice (Arsenal) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
23' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Arsenal are awarded the free kick.
23' John Brooks interrupts the game. One of the players from Newcastle won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Arsenal earn a free kick.
21' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
19' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

19' What a chance that is! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
16' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) makes a strong challenge and John Brooks blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Arsenal in a dangerous position.
15' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

12' 1 - 0 Anthony Gordon showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it into the top of the net – 1:0.

11' That was close by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
10' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Declan Rice (Arsenal) took the corner.
9' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
8' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for holding. John Brooks signals a set piece. Arsenal have a free kick.
5' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
5' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
4' A player from Arsenal commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Newcastle win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

3' A precise low pass is received by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
2' Arsenal are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
John Brooks will officiate today.
